title: C¹ approximation of real Lipschitz functions (Simon Ch. 2, Theorem 1.5)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, K ≥ 0, g : ℝⁿ → ℝ K-Lipschitz and ε ∈ (0, ∞]. There exist a closed set A ⊆ ℝⁿ with Lⁿ(ℝⁿ ∖ A) < ε and a C¹ function h : ℝⁿ → ℝ such that for every x ∈ A, g(x) = h(x) and g is Fréchet differentiable at x with derivative Dh(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : Eucl n → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K g → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ (A : Set (Eucl n)) (h : Eucl n → ℝ), IsClosed A ∧ (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) Aᶜ < ε ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 h ∧ ∀ x ∈ A, g x = h x ∧ HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℝ h x) x
